exec: pm.test('Invalid login is rejected by current middleware mapping', () => pm.expect([401, 403]).to.include(pm.response.code));

pm.test('TeamLead can update member role', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));
pm.test('Developer cannot edit another member', () => pm.response.to.have.status(403));
pm.test('Restored developer is present', () => pm.expect(json.members.some(m => m.userId === pm.environment.get('developerUserId'))).to.eql(true));
pm.test('Main project is listed', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().some(p => p.id === Number(pm.environment.get('projectId')))).to.eql(true));
pm.test('Second active sprint is rejected', () => pm.response.to.have.status(409));

item.name: 09 Business Day Journey
item.description: Realistic in-order business-day flow across workspace managers, developers, temporary members, sprint work, board movement, activity, and visibility.

exec: pm.test('TeamLead can read workspace details', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));

pm.test('Workspace includes active project and members', () => { const json = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(json.projects.length).to.be.greaterThan(0); pm.expect(json.members.some(m => m.userId === pm.environment.get('developerUserId'))).to.eql(true); });

body.raw: {"name":"{{workspaceName}} Daily Ops","description":"Updated by TeamLead during the business-day scenario {{runId}}"}

exec: pm.test('Developer can read updated workspace', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));
pm.test('TeamLead can add temporary member', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));
pm.test('Temporary member can read workspace', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));
pm.test('Temporary member sees own membership', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().members.some(m => m.userId === pm.environment.get('outsiderUserId'))).to.eql(true));
pm.test('TeamLead can update temporary member profile', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));
pm.test('TeamLead can read member detail', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));

pm.test('Temporary member profile persisted', () => { const json = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(json.firstName).to.eql('Temp'); pm.expect(json.githubUsername).to.eql(`postman-temp-${pm.environment.get('runId')}`); });
pm.test('Developer cannot promote another member', () => pm.response.to.have.status(403));

item.name: Developer Lists Sprint Tasks For Standup

exec: pm.test('Developer can list sprint tasks', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));
pm.test('Sprint task list includes developer task', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().some(t => t.id === Number(pm.environment.get('taskAId')))).to.eql(true));
pm.test('Developer can read own task detail', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));
pm.test('Task detail has assignees and dependencies', () => { const json = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(json.assignees).to.be.an('array'); pm.expect(json.dependencies).to.be.an('array'); });

body.raw: {"title":"Midday Bug {{runId}}","description":"Urgent bug found during the business day","status":0,"priority":2,"dueDate":"{{laterEndDate}}","columnId":{{todoColumnId}},"assigneeUserIds":["{{developerUserId}}"]}

exec: pm.test('TeamLead can create midday bug task', () => pm.response.to.have.status(201));
pm.test('Midday bug assigned to developer', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().assignees.some(a => a.userId === pm.environment.get('developerUserId'))).to.eql(true));

item.name: Developer Moves Midday Bug To In Progress

exec: pm.test('Developer can move assigned midday bug', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));
pm.test('Midday bug moved to In Progress', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().columnId).to.eql(Number(pm.environment.get('inProgressColumnId'))));
pm.test('Developer can update assigned task status', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));

item.name: Developer Moves Midday Bug To Done Column

exec: pm.test('Developer can move completed bug to Done column', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));
pm.test('Midday bug is in Done column', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().columnId).to.eql(Number(pm.environment.get('doneColumnId'))));
pm.test('TeamLead can read midday bug activity', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));
pm.test('Midday bug has status or column activity', () => { const fields = pm.response.json().map(l => l.fieldChanged); pm.expect(fields.some(f => ['Status','Column'].includes(f))).to.eql(true); });

item.name: Temporary Member Sees Scoped Board Only

exec: pm.test('Temporary member can read board', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));
pm.test('Temporary member sees no unrelated tasks', () => { const tasks = pm.response.json().columns.flatMap(c => c.tasks); pm.expect(tasks.length).to.eql(0); });

item.name: TeamLead Assigns Temporary Member To Midday Bug

exec: pm.test('TeamLead can assign temporary member', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));
pm.test('Temporary member assigned to midday bug', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().assignees.some(a => a.userId === pm.environment.get('outsiderUserId'))).to.eql(true));

item.name: Temporary Member Board Shows Assigned Work

exec: pm.test('Temporary member can still read board', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));

pm.test('Temporary member sees newly assigned task with reason', () => { const tasks = pm.response.json().columns.flatMap(c => c.tasks); const task = tasks.find(t => t.id === Number(pm.environment.get('middayBugTaskId'))); pm.expect(task).to.exist; pm.expect(task.visibilityReasons).to.include('AssignedToYou'); });

item.name: TeamLead Unassigns Temporary Member From Midday Bug

exec: pm.test('TeamLead can unassign temporary member', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));
pm.test('Temporary member no longer assigned', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().assignees.some(a => a.userId === pm.environment.get('outsiderUserId'))).to.eql(false));

item.name: TeamLead Removes Temporary Member End Of Day

exec: pm.test('TeamLead can remove temporary member', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));

item.name: Removed Temporary Member Cannot Read Workspace

exec: pm.test('Removed temporary member cannot read workspace', () => pm.response.to.have.status(403));
pm.test('Removed member failure uses message shape', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json()).to.have.property('message'));

item.name: TeamLead Restores Temporary Member For Next Day

exec: pm.test('TeamLead can restore temporary member', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));

item.name: Admin End Of Day Board Review Sees All Work

exec: pm.test('Admin can review end-of-day board', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));

pm.test('Admin sees original and midday work', () => { const ids = pm.response.json().columns.flatMap(c => c.tasks).map(t => t.id); ['taskAId','taskBId','taskCId','taskDId','middayBugTaskId'].forEach(k => pm.expect(ids).to.include(Number(pm.environment.get(k)))); });

item.name: Sprint Progress Reflects Business Day Work

exec: pm.test('TeamLead can review sprint progress', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));
pm.test('Progress includes completed midday bug', () => { const json = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(json.totalTasks).to.be.greaterThan(4); pm.expect(json.completedTasks).to.be.greaterThan(0); });
